method: Manual browser acceptance through CUA, plus read-only local HTTP and verification of the actual browser downloads. This is not an automated end-to-end browser suite.
scope: Isolated SQLite and explicitly injected local delay/503 responses with outbound provider HTTP disabled; then main workspace offline upgrade acceptance. No current live-model quality test, mobile-layout acceptance or new upstream test run is claimed.

checks.name: Unified competition entry
checks.observed: A single top-bar competition entry provides quick, full, live-question, preflight and recovery controls; legacy constructed demos are secondary.

checks.name: Read-only preflight
checks.observed: Checks identify local case files, workspace basis, task binding, decisions, model configuration and local usage; zero model calls and no remote balance claim.

checks.name: No-key offline path
checks.observed: The isolated server has no model configuration and blocks outbound provider HTTP; the offline demo still starts with model pairing disabled.

checks.name: One real case at start
checks.observed: Starting a full presentation selects the verified http-server before snapshot and GHSA-xvch-5gv4-984h, independent of the prior synthetic workspace.

checks.name: Seven-stage full presentation
checks.observed: All seven steps were individually opened: source, paths, questions, simulation, plans, timeline and report.

checks.name: Source and representative paths
checks.observed: The source screen discloses fixed commit, MIT and incomplete coverage; the path screen shows direct and indirect minimist paths and truncation.

checks.name: Free-question controls
checks.observed: A question can be typed or chosen from a chip, with explicit before/partial/after material selection and an offline run button.

checks.name: Free questions are unscored
checks.observed: A real offline free question displays unscored on both sides and no invented winner or reference accuracy.

checks.name: Per-column evidence linkage
checks.observed: Clicking the graph column nested minimist fact selects its five-edge path, before lockfile pointer, SHA-256 and original parsed JSON; the other column stays separate.

checks.name: Material phase isolation
checks.observed: Changing the question material to after retrieves after-phase evidence and labels the result as final stage.

checks.name: Failure log linkage
checks.observed: A free failure question shows the saved 393-pass/1-pending/2-failing raw log excerpt, filename and hash; no dependency path is invented for the log.

checks.name: Stop local waiting
checks.observed: With a 35-second injected local delay, stopping restores controls, preserves the draft and says server processing and billing may continue.

checks.name: Explicit service error
checks.observed: An injected HTTP 503 displays a labeled isolated-review error while preserving the question and showing an offline retry control.

checks.name: Explicit offline recovery
checks.observed: After the injected error is removed, clicking the offline retry returns the requested evidence and no model-assisted generation.

checks.name: Bounded offline wait
checks.observed: A 35-second injected delay triggers the actual 30-second UI timeout, preserves the draft and offers recovery; no automatic retry occurs.

checks.name: Interactive simulation
checks.observed: Selecting the direct minimist location changes the hypothetical remaining target count from two to one while retaining the real-case before context.

checks.name: Actual plans remain distinct
checks.observed: Plan A shows two-to-one target matches and one changed location; plan B shows two-to-zero and 381 changes with historical-test and coverage limitations.

checks.name: Failure-to-repair timeline
checks.observed: All five saved events are visible, including the two failures, two assertion API migrations and final 395-pass record; no tests were rerun.

checks.name: Current-session report
checks.observed: The final step displays the current live question and material phase, links back to it and offers the baseline report and public case bundle.

checks.name: Refresh restores navigation only
checks.observed: After reload, explicit resume returns to step seven while the previous question and answer are absent; no model request is automatically triggered.

checks.name: Quick presentation
checks.observed: Starting the quick mode shows exactly four stages: source, questions, plans and report.

checks.name: Preflight outage handling
checks.observed: Injected preflight HTTP 503 replaces readiness with an unavailable message and offers a retry plus previously loaded material continuation.

checks.name: Previously loaded material continuation
checks.observed: The explicit continuation opens the verified in-memory case with a clear statement that current server availability was not rechecked.

checks.name: Free-question JSON export
checks.observed: Browser-downloaded JSON is release 0.9.0, free/unscored, has null reference coverage and zero attempted model calls.

checks.name: Original source download
checks.observed: Browser-downloaded before.package-lock.json bytes exactly match the frozen source file.

checks.name: Evidence package export
checks.observed: Browser-downloaded evidence ZIP has 23 entries, release 0.9.0, correct index hashes and unchanged original case files.

checks.name: Legacy demo still accessible
checks.observed: Explicitly expanding the secondary legacy section and loading its materials succeeds and retains its constructed-data label.

checks.name: Main workspace upgrade
checks.observed: Main server reports 0.9.0, retains verified GPT configuration, passes local preflight and completes the new free-question flow with the model toggle off.

checks.name: Desktop presentation rendering
checks.observed: At the default desktop viewport, live-question controls and side-by-side results are usable; selected fact styling and navigation are visible. No uncaught browser errors were recorded.

checks.name: User records and usage preserved
checks.observed: SQLite table counts match the pre-upgrade backup; before/after local usage has unchanged call count and zero in-flight requests. No paid model calls were added.
